semantics: x,y in original video pixels of the frame decoded in order from 0; visible=false means occluded and the position is the labeller's estimate; points not placed are omitted, and cannot_place lists those the labeller could not place. mode: blind frames showed no model output; origins says, per point, whether the labeller placed it, accepted or corrected a model suggestion (which model), kept an earlier-export point after checking it, or accepted a floor point carried from another frame of the same video

assist.blind_rule: per video: the P1 frame, then the other benchmark frames in order of sha1('swingai-blind-v1' + image_sha1) until 3 are blind; chosen before any model proposal was generated, never from model output
